acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to #/projects/:id fetches the project via GET /api/projects/:id and displays the project's metadata (ID, name, description), repositories list, and workspaces list.
Adding a repository presents a selection from the global repository list (filtered to exclude already-added repos) and calls POST /api/projects/:id/repositories with { repositoryId }.
Removing a repository from the project shows a confirmation dialog and calls DELETE /api/projects/:id/repositories/:repoId on confirm.
The 'Add Workspace' form validates the workspace ID format (2-6 uppercase A-Z letters) and creates the workspace via POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces.
The STABLE workspace's delete button is visually disabled and non-functional.
Renaming a project shows a confirmation dialog, calls PUT /api/projects/:id/rename with { newId }, and navigates to #/projects/:newId on success.

comments.note: project-detail.js: The `refresh()` helper re-renders the whole view by calling renderProjectDetail recursively. For mutation-heavy workflows (e.g., adding several repos in sequence) this triggers three parallel API calls each time. A targeted section re-render (only repos or only workspaces) would be more efficient, but is a deferred optimisation — the current full-refresh approach is correct and readable.

project-detail.js: The normalise* functions (normaliseProject, normaliseRepo, normaliseWorkspace) handle both Go-capitalised and lowercase keys. These patterns are repeated across multiple view files. A shared normalisation utility in a separate module (e.g., gui/public/js/utils/normalise.js) would reduce duplication if more views need the same treatment.

project-detail.js buildMetaSection: The cancelDescBtn click handler sets editRow.hidden to false before setting it to true on the next line (lines 197-200). The first assignment is dead code and can be removed for clarity.

project-detail.js: The module-level `_router` variable uses a leading underscore by convention to signal 'private', which is a reasonable pattern. However app.js also exports setRouter from dashboard.js under the same alias — the naming is consistent across all views and is not a problem, just worth noting for documentation.

[documentation-forward] The `normaliseRepo()` function is duplicated verbatim in both `repositories.js` (line 30) and `project-detail.js` (line 67). The README or architecture doc should note this as a known duplication and flag `gui/public/js/utils/normalise.js` as the suggested location for a future consolidation — so the next developer adding a view does not create a third copy.

[documentation-forward] The `refresh()` pattern (recursive call to `renderProjectDetail` on every mutation) is used in project-detail.js. This is intentional and correct for current scale, but the module-level docstring at the top of the file does not mention it. A brief note in the module JSDoc explaining the full-refresh-on-mutation strategy (and the trade-off against targeted section re-renders) would help future contributors understand the design intent without reading the implementation.
